title: Military Coup Attempt as Fourth Turning Catalyst
statement: At some point the military may attempt a coup — open rupture between uniformed leadership and the regime — and that break may prove to be the big flashpoint that kicks off the Fourth Turning burning cycle. The regime is currently managing this genuine, structural dissent as a 'disloyalty' smokescreen (Quantico 2.0, purge justifications), but the fracture is real: a naked ideologue holds the Department of War, refuses drone modernization, has lost the commanders' confidence, and is losing a war. The dissent is simultaneously a real rupture and a convenient distraction — the smokescreen bottles the steam, so the eventual release is larger, not smaller. Causal chain: SPR Runway Breaks (oil shock) -> military emergency / command pressure -> open rupture between uniformed leaders and regime -> Fourth Turning burning-cycle flashpoint. Coup risk ripens sharply IF the SPR-driven oil shock lands.
evidence_confirmed: Classified Pentagon leak (WaPo): multiple combatant commanders formally 'non-concurred' against Hegseth's Iran escalation, warning of strain on forces and homeland threats
Navy robbing payroll to fund Iran war; accounts running dry
Gutting of career officials / loyalty-oath politicization documented across DHS and military
Generals and admirals now reticent to give unvarnished counsel, war planning internally harmed
Army Secretary Dan Driscoll (Vance loyalist) resigned mid-war citing Hegseth's blocking of Army readiness and drone modernization and firing of generals
War dept launched Grok (xAI/Musk) on GenAI.mil — oligarch AI bolted into war operations chair
Republican infighting openly emerging within Department of War

Hegseth's refusal to modernize with drone units is ideological (legacy warfighting attachment), overriding operational necessity — commanders losing Iran war BECAUSE of it, zero confidence in his strategic/tactical grasp
Pentagon forced to respond/defend — spending vital bandwidth rebutting dissent, launching 'Quantico 2.0' loyalty summons

Sept 1, 2026: JCS Chair Caine publicly declares any order to deploy troops to polls 'unlawful' — formalized public civil-military fracture reinforcing the generals' non-concur; the uniformed command refusing to be election-enforcement arm.

Sept 1, 2026 (RawStory): Trump warns Iran 'wiped out as a country' in Fox phone call after Strait strikes; analysts including sanctions expert Brett Erickson read this as signaling nuclear weapons 'on the table now'. This escalation-to-catastrophe rhetoric is the exact class of decision the uniformed command's non-concur exists to check -- validates that the generals' formal dissent targets civilian leadership flooring the nuclear-ladder accelerator.

Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns mid-war after direct clash with Hegseth and Trump (who pivoted from war strategy to White House ballroom complaints), leaving the Army's top command structure vacant (no Secretary, no Chief of Staff, no confirmed ops general, no confirmed European commander) (Aug 31 - Sept 2, 2026).

Former Air Force Secretary Frank Kendall III New York Times op-ed (Sept 1-2, 2026): Publicly accuses senior military leaders of 'denial' and a 'cop-out' for normalizing unconstitutional orders under Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Explicitly cites extrajudicial executions at sea, unauthorized war on Iran, and unauthorized domestic National Guard deployments, confirming lower-level officers are 'privately appalled' but silenced by fear of career ruin.
evidence_contradicted: Pentagon spokesman publicly downplaying the dissent; regime still holding command cohesion for now
Regime successfully using dissent as distraction to legitimize purges (Quantico 2.0) — near-term extraction managed
falsifier: The uniformed command does NOT rupture: no further formal non-concurrence, no resignation cascade beyond Driscoll, no refusal of unlawful orders, and the regime retains command cohesion through the crisis - the real-fracture thesis proves containable and the smokescreen framing fails.
forward_watchlist: Further formal non-concur filings or public reservations from combatant commanders against the Sept 1 strike campaign (the taper test).
Whether the acting-Army-secretary gap (Telle) is filled with a loyalist or a commands-confidence choice - a tell on whether the fracture heals or widens.
Any open public break between JCS Chair Caine and Hegseth/Trump on election troops or nuclear-ladder rhetoric.
Senior officers privately appalled going public (Kendall op-ed class) - the pressure-vent release.
A fabricated coup narrative being seeded to justify a purge (the smokescreen deployment).
